name: Static-Dynamic Depth Sorting with Exact Reuse Certificate
definition: A sorting optimization that separates Gaussians into static (S) and dynamic (D) sets, sorts them independently, and merges them. It allows reusing the committed draw list πc if the relative order of Gaussians has not changed, verified by a depth-motion bound.
summary: Static-Dynamic Depth Sorting with Exact Reuse Certificate optimizes 4D Gaussian Splatting by caching static depth orders and using a closed-form motion bound to mathematically guarantee visual consistency for reused frames.
